name: 3 · Factory floor
author: OpenTactics
description: Build an army and stop the raid.

mission.briefing: A raiding party is coming for our headquarters. Use the factory to build units and wipe the raiders out.

hints.text: Tap your factory (next to the headquarters) to build. Units cannot move on the day they are built.
Tanks are strong against vehicles, mechs are cheap tank-killers, infantry are cheap and capture.
Every property you own pays you at the start of your turn.
Units on your cities and headquarters are repaired a little each turn, for a share of their price.
